title.zh: 外购件短缺采购响应助手

summary.zh: 联结 MRP 短缺、采购申请、采购订单交期和有效货源，给出可审计的释放、转换与催交建议。
summary.en: Links MRP shortages, requisitions, PO schedules, and valid sources into auditable release, conversion, and expediting recommendations.

zh: 只读，不创建或修改采购凭证
单位不可比时不计算确定缺口
ADT 仅在 API 证据不足时调用并以实时 DDIC 校验
缺失、超时和截断不得解释为零记录
en: Read-only; never create or change purchasing documents
Do not calculate a confirmed gap when units are incomparable
Call ADT only when API evidence is insufficient and validate against live DDIC metadata
Never interpret missing, timed-out, or truncated evidence as zero records

plan.rationale: Confirm that the exact MRP material is externally procured and read its base-unit parameters.
Collect bounded purchase requisition core evidence.
Read the target-system processing status exposed for exact purchase-requisition items.
Collect bounded PO item core evidence before schedule fallback.
Join exact PO items to headers, schedule lines, receipts, returns, reversals, and posting dates so overdue open quantities are based on net goods receipts rather than supplier commitment quantities.
Read optional supplier names and purchasing contacts for the exact PO suppliers without making contact availability a prerequisite for the procurement conclusion.
Read source-list evidence from the organization/plant purchasing-info-record entity exposed by live metadata.

acceptance.recordScope: Return only authoritative MaterialCoverages rows as comparison records. MRP master data, SupplyDemandItems, purchase requisitions, PO schedule lines, and source candidates are contextual evidence summarized by metrics or diagnostics, not comparison records.

metricDefinitions.pr_action_total: Count exact material/plant PR items with ProcessingStatus=N, positive requested quantity minus ordered quantity, and no deletion or close indicator.
metricDefinitions.pr_awaiting_release: Count actionable PR items whose release status is 03 or 04.
metricDefinitions.pr_ready_to_convert: Count actionable PR items whose release status is 05, release is complete, and a source or fixed supplier is assigned.
metricDefinitions.pr_source_or_processing_required: Count actionable PR items that require version completion, active processing, or source assignment before PO conversion.
metricDefinitions.po_schedule_lines_to_expedite: Count exact material/plant PO schedule lines whose delivery date is before the as-of date and whose order quantity exceeds net goods receipts posted by the as-of date, after unit validation and stable schedule allocation.
metricDefinitions.valid_source_candidates: Count exact purchasing-organization/plant info-record rows that are not marked for deletion and are relevant for automatic sourcing.

acceptance.businessStatusDefinition: Use attention when shortage_quantity, pr_action_total, or po_schedule_lines_to_expedite is positive; use normal only when all three are zero. Test-data qualification BLOCKED is a separate acceptance verdict and must not replace this business status.
acceptance.testDataQualificationDefinition: A sample is qualified when the authoritative coverage shortage is positive and active at the as-of date, MRP master data confirms external procurement category F, and all required source queries are complete. Complete exact zero-row PR, PO schedule, or source branches establish zero and do not disqualify the sample. MRP snapshot staleness is a non-blocking warning.
